_comment: Corpus for tuning MusicBrainz release selection (lookup_musicbrainz).
Each entry is a track we ask MusicBrainz about, plus what a sane human would
consider an acceptable album to tag it with. `accept` holds case-insensitive
substrings; a pick counts as correct if it matches any of them. We deliberately
do NOT demand one exact title, because MusicBrainz has four spellings of most
things and this exercise is about not tagging Nevermind as a Bristol bootleg,
not about winning a pedantry contest.
`category` groups the failure modes we actually care about:
bootleg_heavy       - artists whose search results drown in live recordings
compilation_heavy   - dance/electronic tracks that live on 400 compilations
mainstream          - ordinary pop/rock, the easy case, guards against regressions
single_only         - genuinely released as a single, so a single IS correct
non_english_native  - queried in the native script, should already work
non_english_roman   - queried romanised, which is what YouTube hands us
Refresh the cached MusicBrainz responses with tests/tools/refresh_mb_corpus.py
